showBasicActions.name: Show Basic Actions
showBasicActions.hint: Shows Dodge, Ready, Dash and Hide on the Action panel.

switchEquip.name: Equip on set change
switchEquip.hint: Automatically equips and unequips weapons when changing weapon sets. Disabled by default to avoid accidental sheet changes.

showFavorites.name: Show Favorites
showFavorites.hint: Adds OPRPG character favorites to the HUD.

showHaki.name: Show Haki
showHaki.hint: Shows a button that opens the native Haki HUD when available.

showAkuma.name: Show Devil Fruit
showAkuma.hint: Shows a dedicated panel for Devil Fruit techniques and Power Manifestations.

movementMode.name: Movement Indicator
movementMode.hint: Choose how movement is displayed. Simple mode respects the actor movement unit and converts scene distance when possible.

diagnosticMode.name: Diagnostic Mode
diagnosticMode.hint: Adds a diagnostic button to the portrait and enables OPRPG_ARGON_DIAGNOSTIC() in the Console.

weaponSetMode.name: Weapon Set Mode
weaponSetMode.hint: Visual only changes HUD shortcuts. Equipment also equips/unequips items on the actor.

layoutPreset.name: Technique Card Size
layoutPreset.hint: Changes expanded Technique card size for this client.

utilityGap.name: Top Icon Spacing
utilityGap.hint: Pixel gap between initiative, open sheet, Haki/diagnostic and minimize controls.

utilityOffset.name: Gap After Weapon Sets
utilityOffset.hint: Pixel gap between the last Weapon Set and the first utility icon.

techniqueOffsetX.name: Technique Horizontal Offset
techniqueOffsetX.hint: Moves the expanded Technique panel left (negative) or right (positive), in pixels.

utilityAnchor.name: Top Icon Anchor
utilityAnchor.hint: Places utility icons after the active two-slot weapon set or after the entire Weapon Sets area.

favoritesPlacement.name: Favorites placement
favoritesPlacement.hint: Choose where actor Favorites appear in the HUD.

favoritesMax.name: Maximum HUD Favorites
favoritesMax.hint: Limits how many Favorites are shown to avoid an excessively wide action bar.

hud.rememberActivity: The last used form is preselected on this browser.
hud.effectSuppressed: Effect is suppressed and cannot be toggled right now.
hud.noEffectPermission: You do not have permission to change this effect.
hud.compatibilityHint: Alt-click the diagnostic button to open this panel. Shift-click exports JSON; Ctrl-click runs self-test.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.desc: Focus on avoiding attacks until the start of your next turn.
dodge.active: Dodge is active until the start of your next turn.

ready.name: Ready
ready.desc: Choose a perceivable trigger and an action to perform with your Reaction.
ready.noActivities: No usable action was found to ready.
ready.triggerPlaceholder: E.g. when the enemy crosses the door
ready.hint: The action is executed with your Reaction when you click Execute on the card. It expires at the start of your next turn.
ready.missingData: Enter a trigger and choose an action.
ready.notFound: The readied action no longer exists.
ready.activityMissing: The readied Activity could not be found.
ready.executeFailed: Failed to execute the readied action. See the console.

dash.name: Dash
dash.desc: Gain additional movement equal to your current movement.
dash.alreadyActive: Dash is already active this turn.

hide.name: Hide
hide.skillFallback: Stealth skill not found; rolling Dexterity instead.
hide.noRollApi: This actor has no compatible Stealth/Dexterity roll API.

basic.noActor: Select a token/actor to use this action.
basic.noPermission: You do not have permission to modify this actor.
